subject: Observa Labs: marketplace bundling & co-sell orchestration
messages:
From: Emma Li <emma@observa.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: partners@observa.com
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Listing + co-sell — Observa x Redwood (intro)

Hi Olga,

Hope you’re well — I’m Emma, Head of Partnerships at Observa Labs. We’ve been evaluating Redwood Inference for a managed inference bundle we plan to list across AWS Marketplace, GCP Marketplace, and Azure Marketplace. Our product is a monitoring + instrumentation suite for LLM serving.

We’d like to explore a co-sell arrangement and understand Redwood’s evidence & technical onboarding requirements for multi-cloud listings. Can we schedule a 30-min sync next week?

Quick context:
- We plan to bundle our agent telemetry plugin with a Redwood-hosted model offering.
- Target launch: Q2 2026 (pilot with a handful of joint customers).
- Primary ask: marketplace eligibility checklist, co-sell MRA expectations, and any billing/metering constraints.

Attached: Observa_Marketplace_Request.xlsx — fills out basic listing info.

Thanks,
Emma Li
Head of Partnerships | Observa Labs
emma@observa.com
--Attachment: Observa_Marketplace_Request.xlsx (spreadsheet, 120KB)

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Li <emma@observa.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Listing + co-sell — Observa x Redwood (intro)

Thanks Emma — excited to partner here. I’ve looped in Ben (partner ops), Vivek (co-sell enablement), and Lauren (catalog/legal intake) so we can triage the marketplace path.

High level next steps I propose:
1) Intake review (this thread) — confirm required evidence and shared responsibilities.
2) Technical evidence pass — Ben will scope marketplace technical artifacts (SaaS integration docs, API endpoints, metering points).
3) Commercial — Lauren will start the co-sell terms intake and surface any redlines.
4) Pilot plan + mutual action plan (MAP) — schedule a follow-up with your product + sales leads.

Requests for you before the sync:
- Can you confirm whether Observa will be the listing owner (publisher) or if Redwood will publish a co-branded offering?
- Share a filled MRA (we reviewed the XLSX; a PDF MRA with signatures speeds legal).
- Any compliance evidence (SOC2 or ISO27001) you can share up front.

I’m available Wed or Thu 9–12 PT for a quick call; if that works for you, propose a time and we’ll send a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Sr. Partner Programs Manager | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai
--Attachment: obs-co-sell-checklist.pdf (PDF, 85KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Emma Li <emma@observa.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Listing + co-sell — Observa x Redwood (intro)

+1 on taking the technical lead. Emma — to help scope, could you confirm the following before Wed:
- Public endpoints or connector architecture for the Observa plugin (sample manifests or OpenAPI spec)
- Expected metering event (per-agent-instance, per-GB, per-token?)
- Whether you need Redwood to act as the metered publisher or if Observa will meter and bill separately (this impacts listing SKU design)

I’ll draft the technical evidence checklist and a quick mapping doc for AWS/GCP/Azure differences — specifically: billing SKU mapping, required publisher forms, and allowed bundling models.

Ben Carter
Head of Partner Ops | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
--Attachment: redlines_co_sell_terms.docx (docx, 45KB)

From: Raj Singh <raj@observa.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emma Li <emma@observa.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Listing + co-sell — Observa x Redwood (intro)

Thanks for the quick turnaround — a few answers inline (quoting your points):

> Public endpoints or connector architecture for the Observa plugin (sample manifests or OpenAPI spec)
We can share an OpenAPI v3 spec and short demo manifest by EOD Friday.

> Expected metering event (per-agent-instance, per-GB, per-token?)
Metering will be per-agent-instance with an optional volume tier (we can provide usage CSVs for the pilot).

> Whether you need Redwood to act as the metered publisher or if Observa will meter and bill separately
Observa would prefer to be the publisher on Marketplace (we hold existing billing relationships with some customers), but we are open to co-managed billing if that simplifies the initial pilot.

We attached a partially filled MRA and initial SOC2 cert snapshot. Can you confirm the minimum evidence you need for AWS vs GCP vs Azure?

Looking to schedule the sync: Thu 2/26 at 10:00 PT works for us.

—Raj
Raj Singh
Product Partnerships | Observa Labs
raj@observa.com
--Attachment: Observa_MRA_partial.pdf (PDF, 220KB)
--Attachment: Observa_SOC2_summary.pdf (PDF, 160KB)

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Li <emma@observa.com>, Raj Singh <raj@observa.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 11:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Listing + co-sell — Observa x Redwood (intro)

Perfect — thanks Raj. Confirmed for Thu 2/26 10:00 PT; I’ll send a calendar invite with a short agenda. Agenda will include:
- Intake review (who publishes, billing model decision)
- Technical evidence and metering mapping (Ben leads)
- Commercial intake & redlines (Lauren leads)
- Pilot MAP + timeline (owner & milestones)

Pre-work (please upload to the shared drive before the call):
- OpenAPI spec + demo manifest (Raj)
- Completed MRA (or the current partial MRA) — we’ll treat this as the source of truth for commercial intake
- SOC2 summary + any additional compliance artifacts (Emma)

I’ll include a DocuSign link for a standard mutual NDA (we can skip if you have an existing mutual NDA on file). If Observa will be the publisher, Lauren will need the billing contact and org address to complete publisher forms for each marketplace.

See you Thu — I’ll include a short pre-read (tech checklist + draft MAP) in the invite.

Regards,
Olga Petrov
Sr. Partner Programs Manager | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai
--Attachment: obs-cosell-map-draft.pdf (PDF, 120KB)
